data.name: Power of Desert (Quvvat ul-Sahro)
data.detailed_description:
Step into the world of medieval Central Asia during the golden age of science, culture, and Islamic renaissance.

Power of Desert is a story-driven single-player RPG inspired by Uzbek folklore, Turkic legends, and the spirit of ancient warriors. Experience a cinematic journey where honor, family, and destiny collide in a land threatened by invasion.

Play as a young warrior determined to save his family and protect his homeland from ruthless enemies. Travel through deserts, ancient cities, fortresses, and sacred lands inspired by the history and culture of Turkic peoples.

Master unique weapons with distinct combat mechanics, combine their powers, and develop your own fighting style. Every weapon carries its own history, abilities, and strategic depth.

FEATURES:

• Story-driven cinematic adventure
• World inspired by Uzbek and Turkic folklore
• Medieval Central Asian setting during the Islamic Golden Age
• Unique weapon mechanics and combat combinations
• Character progression and customization
• Atmospheric soundtrack inspired by traditional culture
• Exploration of ancient cities, deserts, and historical architecture
• Emotional narrative about family, sacrifice, and honor

Discover the power buried beneath the sands.

Power of Desert is a story-driven, single-player RPG inspired by Uzbek folklore, Turkic legends, and the spirit of ancient warriors. A cinematic journey awaits!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-14600KF / AMD Ryzen 5 8600G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
